name: cover
about: A hostile ranged Troika human whose enemy (the UNARMED player) is in the open takes the tactical cover search (0x102b7110 -> FindHintByClassMask(8, 1, radius)) into SCHED_TROIKA_TAKE_COVER_HINT 0x9b (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_take_cover_hint.sch: TASK_GET_PATH_TO_HINTNODE, TASK_RUN_PATH, TASK_WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT, TASK_SNAP_TO_HINT, TASK_FACE_ENEMY, TASK_PLAY_COVER_IDLE, TASK_REMEMBER MEMORY:INCOVER, TASK_SET_NPC_FLAG AT_COVER_HINT) with a cover hint claimed (0x102d1350). From cover, the cover chooser 0x102b7690's cover tail (AT_COVER_HINT set) computes the enemy's ranged threat from the ENEMY's active weapon's slot-360 capability word & 0x6000 (weapon slot 360 answers 0, 0x2000 ranged or 0x40018000 melee: conditions-and-states.md 'CapabilitiesGet'); an unarmed player carries no 0x6000, so bVar1 (melee threat) stays true and, with 0x102b5de0 passing and COVER_VS_MELEE_MODE clear, the answer is 0xa4 SCHED_TROIKA_TAKE_COVER_HINT_VS_MELEE (line 0x5cc3), never 0xa3 _ATTACK (that is the ranged-threat arm: combat/cover_armed). sched_troika_take_cover_hint_vs_melee.sch: SET_NPC_FLAG TASKS_FACE_ENEMY, SNAP_TO_HINT, RESOLVE_BOTCH_IN_COVER, PLAY_COVER_OUTOF (RunTask 0x102ab834 completes on IsActivityFinished, m_bSequenceFinished raised by StudioFrameAdvance 0x1008f120), SET_NPC_FLAG COVER_VS_MELEE_MODE, PLAY_COVER_AIM, SET_SCHEDULE _VS_MELEE_ATK; sched_troika_take_cover_hint_vs_melee_atk.sch: SNAP_TO_HINT, WAIT_RANDOM 0.5, ANNOUNCE_ATTACK 1, TASK_RANGE_ATTACK1. Corrected 2026-10-04 (V1 lane K): the record expected _ATTACK against an unarmed player, a record error. The gunman on far_ne, the player at the cover seat. The run to cover fires on the move (V4o, `cover_move_shoot`).
